evals.name: mcpp-rfp-customer-pains
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. Build customer pains slice only: explicit, latent, and structural program-office pain points with visibility, rationale, readiness_link, and source_chunk_ids. Log missing pain evidence in claim_gaps[].
evals.expected_output: artifacts/pains_handoff.json with >=3 cited customer_pain_points covering mixed visibility types
expectations: completes in under 120 seconds wall time
runs at most one kg_chunks pass for shipley_pains surface
does not call kg_chunks after retrieval_plan.json plan_complete is true
includes at least one explicit and one latent or structural pain when evidence supports
does not emit eval_crosswalk or innovation_opportunities (sibling slices)
solo platform gate passes on pains_handoff.json

evals.name: honest-gaps-when-thin
evals.prompt: Workspace with sparse pain extraction. Emit best-effort customer_pain_points for grounded pains; log ungrounded pain themes in claim_gaps[] by name.
evals.expected_output: Partial pains handoff plus explicit claim_gaps — no invented audit findings
expectations: claim_gaps[] names missing pain evidence when rows are thin
no scaffold pains with placeholder rationale text
undefined acronyms expanded as Full Term (ACR) or repaired by platform finalize

evals.name: retrieval-discipline-regression
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. One kg_entities + one kg_chunks for shipley_pains, then draft pains_handoff.json without re-querying.
